input.title: Fix "Malformed row" error message for column mismatch in CSV uploads
input.body:
File: src/i18n/en.json

The error message "Malformed row: the number of columns does not match the header" is misleading when the issue is caused by a tool on Windows converting CSV files to a different format (e.g., adding or removing columns). Update the message to clarify that the problem is likely due to an external tool altering the file structure, and suggest re-uploading the original file or checking the file format.
